lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a multi-row grid starting posterior to the pectoral fin. The primary row follows the lateral midline with approximately equidistant spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, aligning with the columns of circular blobs along the mid-to-posterior flank, forming a checkered pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features are present along the upper and middle flank, showing a sharp transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), particularly visible along the lateral line trajectory.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of white spots, with one prominent high-luminance blob near the leading edge and smaller, less defined clusters towards the posterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated, low-luminance appendages are visible trailing from the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and mid-ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense population of small, high-frequency white spots is concentrated on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
